recipe.trainer: v3/qad191/qad191.py (qad181.py + flags), run191.sh, one R9700 a run, box2
recipe.schedule: WSD, linear decay to 0 over the last 20% of the (end-to-end) budget
recipe.S: every arm trains the trunk suh / svh log multipliers (#181 arm A)
recipe.fixed_eval: --fixed-eval 30000 --fe-seed 2181: #181's 38 held-out qad-pool docs, removed from every arm's training data
recipe.data: w154's goldens (xq-c00..39, xc8k-b3-c0..4, tr32k) + gen masks, calib qad pool

L.init: A [r, k] ~ N(0, 1/k) seeded per linear (index), B [n, r] = 0, f32
L.lr: 0.0001 (#165's adapter lr), same WSD shape as the scales, no clamp; Adam on the CPU (masters f32)

B.what: block stage on the documents of the plan's first 25% of the budget's gen rows (one layer at a time, inputs = the student's own trajectory from the served token table, targets = the bf16 checkpoint layer on the bf16 trajectory, per-token relative MSE, fresh Adam per layer, warmup 2 batches, decay to 0 over the last 20% of the batches, one pass); then the end-to-end stage on the remaining plan steps (fresh Adam, own warmup 8 and decay over its last 20%) to the same 1M end

T.what: + weight x sum over the segment's gen rows of mean over taps of |s - t|^2 / |t|^2, taps = layers 5/19/33/47/61 outputs (DFlash2 target_layer_ids), teacher = the bf16 checkpoint (stored per data order by --make-taps)
T.weight_rule: KL / T-term ratio of the untrained student over the first 4 plan steps of order A, rounded to 1 significant digit

Q.what: a8g128 fake quant on every trunk linear's input (STE), #181 arm Q

D.minus: #181's order (seeded shuffle of all documents, seed 0)
D.plus: --mix50 191 (half calib qad pool, half xcorp by gen rows)
D.note: RULES191 calls D- '80 % xcorp, 20 % qad pool'; #181's order realises the calib share shown in streams.A (by gen rows to the budget)

design: 2^4 in L, B, T, Q; D = L.B.T.Q (+-1 coding; resolution V); + the D- S-only reference (17th)

judge.response: per arm: mean KL over the gen rows of both sets pooled (torch path with A8: tscore191.py, carried 2,048-token segments); also each set alone
judge.served: L-off arms + the untrained control through eval191.py (the incumbent's mix with the pack of the trained level); torch vs served on the S-only reference; gate: the control's pack path vs the incumbent's own mix (fe38)
judge.analysis: analyse191.py: main effects and two-way interactions as contrasts of log KL over the 16 arms (mean at + minus mean at -), 95% CIs by a per-document bootstrap (documents resampled within each set, jointly across all arms, 2,000 replicates, seed 0); every arm vs the reference (paired ratio, same bootstrap); a factor helps if its main effect's CI is below 0
